target: Field Collector offline shell, encrypted browser queue, and reconnect client
api: temporary same-origin mock; in-memory synthetic device and sync response
steps: Created and enrolled one synthetic browser device while the temporary origin was available.
Confirmed the service-worker cache contained only /mobile and /field-collector-vault.js.
Stopped the temporary origin and reopened /mobile from the service-worker cache.
Unlocked the encrypted IndexedDB vault, saved one synthetic field note, and confirmed one pending record.
Reloaded while the origin remained unavailable, unlocked the vault again, and confirmed the encrypted queue still contained one record.
Restarted the same mock API; sync returned one accepted client ID and the UI cleared the queue. The mock logged POST /api/mobile/sync with HTTP 200.
Removed the test origin's service-worker registration, shell cache, and kokonut-field-vault IndexedDB database.
limitations: This was a real browser UI run, but not OS airplane mode: the loopback server was stopped while the browser's network interface remained up, so navigator.onLine still reported Online.
The sync endpoint was a temporary mock, not the candidate Gateway or PostgreSQL database; live API enrollment-to-sync was accepted separately in candidate recovery evidence.
No photo/media transfer, real OIDC login, consent-required/retired form, or downstream eligibility behavior was exercised in this browser slice.
No Docker container or database was started, changed, or queried.
